about:
# B.O.L.T

**Brittle and Occasionally Lethal Tweaks**: small quality-of-life upgrades for World of Warcraft. BOLT tidies up Blizzard's own UI with Blizzard's own art and adds a handful of handy tools, without changing how the game plays.

| Game version | Status |
|---|---|
| **WoW: Forever** | ✅ Fully supported, with extra Forever-only features and Forever's bronze UI art |
| **Retail (Midnight 12.1.5)** | ✅ Fully supported |

One download works on both. BOLT detects which game it runs in: features that need modern systems (Skyriding, Mythic+ keys, achievements...) hide themselves on Forever, and Forever-only features hide on Retail.

![A clean screen with BOLT: faded bars, Personal Resource Display with pet bar, My Damage and the square minimap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yukisando/B.O.L.T/main/.github/screenshots/overview.jpg)

---

## ⭐ New on WoW: Forever

These features only exist on WoW: Forever, built around its classic-style systems:

- **Quick Feed (hunters)**: the pet health bar takes your pet's mood colour (green, amber, red) and softly pulses when your pet is hungry. Click it to feed the cheapest food your pet eats, without opening your bags. Shift-click feeds it any time. Hover it to see the food and your pet's mood.
- **Full Swing Timer**: main hand, off hand and ranged swings, for every class, read from the game's own swing timer.
- **Campfire Rest**: near a campfire, a small panel in the My Damage style lists the camp benefits resting there gives you, with a Sit button and one bar for the warm-up, then their time left.
- **DoT Overlay**: a striped shield on enemy nameplates shows how much damage your DoTs (and your pet's) will still deal. It turns gold when they alone will finish the mob.
- **Attack Key**: one key targets the enemy under the mouse, sends your pet in and starts your wand. Hunters get Auto Shot, or a melee swing when the enemy is too close.
- **Hawk and Totem Timers**: your hunter's hawk as a round countdown node above the pet bar.
- **Ammo Count**: after each shot, how many arrows or bullets you have left.
- **Day/Night Dial**: Forever's day/night dial sits inside the square minimap.
- **Bronze Art**: every restyled frame uses Forever's own bronze UI art, so it looks like it shipped with the game.
- **Wowhead Links** point to Wowhead's Forever database.

![Quick Feed: hovering the pet bar shows the food it will use and your pet's mood](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yukisando/B.O.L.T/main/.github/screenshots/quick-feed.jpg)

---

## Getting started

1. Install from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/bolt) (or put the `BOLT` folder in `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\` or `\_retail_\Interface\AddOns\`).
2. Type `/bolt` in game. **Every feature starts off**: tick the ones you want.
3. Open **Edit Mode** (ESC > Edit Mode) and click a Blizzard frame (minimap, action bars, player frame...). A **B.O.L.T** panel next to the Edit Mode window lists what BOLT can do to that frame.

Your BOLT setup is saved with each Edit Mode layout and shared by all your characters: switch layout and your BOLT setup switches with it.

![Edit Mode: the Minimap's B.O.L.T panel with screen edge, square minimap, buttons and fade options](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yukisando/B.O.L.T/main/.github/screenshots/edit-mode.jpg)

---

## What's inside

Features marked **Forever** only appear on WoW: Forever; **Retail** ones only on Retail. Everything else works on both.

### Interface

Blizzard's own frames, restyled with Blizzard's own art.

#### Cooldown Sans font

The game's text in Cooldown Sans, ColdSnap's own rounded typeface made to be easy to read. On by default, and you pick where it goes under Interface in the settings: the interface (menus, tooltips, unit frames, quests), chat and chat bubbles, nameplates, names above characters, damage numbers on enemies, and the combat text above you. Names and damage numbers follow a change after logging out to the character list and back in. Other addons keep their own fonts. Not used on Korean and Chinese clients.

#### Square Minimap

![Square minimap on Retail: faded FPS beside the clock, coordinates in the corner, and B.O.L.T toggles in the tracking menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yukisando/B.O.L.T/main/.github/screenshots/minimap.jpg)

- A square map in Blizzard's minimap frame, with the zone name and clock in a title bar.
- Tracking, calendar, mail and the other minimap buttons in one tidy bar (bottom, top, left or right).
- Addon buttons go into one drawer that opens on click. Drag one onto the button bar to pin it at the far end.
- Coordinates in one corner, your movement speed in the other, a resting Zzz, the day/night dial (**Forever**).
- A faded FPS counter next to the clock, if you want it.
- Optional mouse-wheel zoom.
- **Snug in the corner**: drag the map right against the screen edge, or even partly off screen. It stays there after a reload.
- Pauses itself while SexyMap, BasicMinimap or ElvUI is loaded.

#### Personal Resource Display

![The Personal Resource Display in Edit Mode on Retail, with its B.O.L.T panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yukisando/B.O.L.T/main/.github/screenshots/personal-resource-display.jpg)

Blizzard's health and power bars under your character, made into a complete mini HUD:

- **Pet health bar** above your health bar, coloured by your pet's mood on Forever, with **Quick Feed** (**Forever**). Click it like the Pet Frame.
- **Target bars**: your target's health, plus your target's target on the same row. Clickable like unit frames.
- **Hawk and totem timers** as round nodes above the pet bar.
- **Pet damage share** after each fight, **ammo count** after each shot (**Forever**).
- Show it in combat only, also with a target, or faded out of combat to an opacity of your choice (with Blizzard's Visibility on In Combat or Always).
- **Hide the Player and Target frames** and bring each back in combat, with a target or on hover, for a clean, immersive screen.

#### Swing Timer

- A faint sweep across the Personal Resource Display's bars between your auto attacks, so you can fit casts in between. Floating bars if you prefer.
- **Forever**: main hand, off hand and ranged, every class. **Retail**: Auto Shot only (the game reports no other swings).

#### Unit Frames and Cast Bars

- Player, target, focus, target of target, pet and party frames without the round portrait: the bars widen to fill the space.
- Cast bars with the spell name inside the bar.
- Party members' names in their class colour.
- Raid-style party frames stay centred as people join and leave.

#### Nameplates

- **Interrupt cue**: an enemy cast bar lights up with your interrupt's icon when you can kick it right now.
- **Range hint**: enemies out of your reach get a darker health bar.
- **Target emphasis**: your target's plate grows, the others fade a little.
- **Healer and caster highlight**: enemy mana users in a colour of your choice.
- **Friendly target plate**: only the friend you target shows a nameplate.
- **DoT Overlay** (**Forever**): see above. `/bolt dots` lists what it counts.

#### Auto-hide UI

- Put frames (action bars, micro menu, bags, XP bar, buffs, unit frames, quest tracker, minimap, chat) in up to four **fade groups**.
- Each group fades back in by its own rules: mouse over, combat, a target, in a group, in an instance, and not while mounted.
- Set it from any frame in Edit Mode.

#### Small fixes

- The quest tracker remembers whether you collapsed it.

### Gameplay

- **Attack Key** (**Forever**): one key for wand or Auto Shot (melee swing up close), pet attack, and the pet set to Assist or Defensive (your pick).
- **My Damage**: a small, quiet panel with only your numbers: your rank in the group, your dps, and your spells and pets. Left-click it for this fight or the overall total, right-click for your spells or the whole group (one line per player, in class colours). Opacity and click-through are set in Edit Mode.

  ![My Damage beside the minimap on Retail: your spells for the overall session](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yukisando/B.O.L.T/main/.github/screenshots/my-damage.jpg)
- **Cheetah Warning** (hunters): a gentle reminder when you enter combat with Aspect of the Cheetah or the Pack on.
- **Double-Click Fishing**: double right-click the world to cast Fishing.
- **Skyriding** (**Retail**): strafe keys turn while skyriding, with optional pitch control.

### Quality of Life

- **Game Menu buttons**: Leave Group, Reload UI, ready check, pull countdown, raid marker, volume and mute, combat text toggles, and loot spec switching (**Retail**), as round minimap-style buttons around the menu.

  ![BOLT's round buttons around the Retail game menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yukisando/B.O.L.T/main/.github/screenshots/game-menu.jpg)
- **Campfire Rest** (**Forever**): see above.
- **Auto Rep Switch**: the reputation bar follows the faction you just gained rep with.
- **Mail Address Book**: at a mailbox your bags open, and the last 5 characters you mailed are one click away.
- **Saved Instances**: your dungeon and raid lockouts. `/boltsaved`
- **Smart Teleport** (**Retail**): every teleport you own for the zone you're viewing, under the World Map.

### Social

- **Chat**: Blizzard's chat made quiet. No borders or button clutter, text only while you look at it, chat history kept after a reload, copy chat, a sound on new messages, and small popups for whispers, party chat, skill ups, money, rep and XP.
- **Auto Party Chat**: the chat box switches to Party, Raid or Instance when you join a group, and back to Say when you leave.
- **Wowhead Link**: hover almost anything and press Ctrl+C for its Wowhead link.

### Roleplay

- **Transmog Presets**: save looks once and use them on any character.
- **Everyday Emotes**: one key each for Hello, Goodbye, Thanks and Sit, and an automatic thank-you to players who buff you.
- **Total RP 3**: a key to switch In Character / Out of Character, with an optional UI layout for each.

### Extras

- **Playground**: a favourite toy button and copy your target's mount (`/cm`).
- **Sound Muter**: mute any game sound by its ID.
- **Character Snapshot**: export your character's stats as JSON.
- **Achievement Tracker** and **Key Share** (**Retail**): achievement progress messages in chat, and `!keys` replies with a keystone roulette.

---

## Settings and commands

- `/bolt` (or `/b`) opens the settings, also at ESC > Options > AddOns > B.O.L.T.
- Frame options live in **Edit Mode**: click a frame and use its B.O.L.T panel.
- Quick on/off toggles in the minimap tracking menu.

![The B.O.L.T settings page in the game's AddOns options](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Yukisando/B.O.L.T/main/.github/screenshots/settings.jpg)

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/bolt` | Open settings |
| `/bolt help` | List all commands |
| `/bolt status` | Which features are on |
| `/bolt transmog` | Transmog Presets |
| `/bolt edge` | What the minimap's screen-edge setting is doing |
| `/bolt dots` | What the DoT Overlay counts on your target (Forever) |
| `/bolt camp` | What the camp panel sees, for bug reports (Forever) |
| `/bolt reset` | Clear stuck Skyriding keys (Retail) |
| `/boltsaved` | Your current lockouts |
| `/cm` | Summon your target's mount |

---

Bugs and ideas: [GitHub issues](https://github.com/Yukisando/B.O.L.T/issues).

# B.O.L.T Changelog

**(Brittle and Occasionally Lethal Tweaks)**

Entries below the marker are added automatically by the release workflow from commit messages — newest first.

## v8-48 (2026-11-26)

- feat: mail address book, pin addon buttons to the minimap bar, pet mode for the Attack Key
- New Mail Address Book: at a mailbox your bags open, and the last 5 characters you sent mail to sit beside the Send Mail tab; click one to fill the To field, right-click to take it off
- The recent mail list is shared by all your characters
- Minimap: drag an addon button from the drawer onto the button bar to pin it at the far end, drag it off to put it back
- Pinned buttons keep all their own clicks and are the same on every character
- Attack Key: new Pet mode choice, Assist, Defensive, or leave the pet's mode alone (your old Assist setting carries over)

## v8-47 (2026-11-25)

- feat: chat window rebuilt, smaller chat text, tracker background fix
- Chat text has room inside its frame and never runs under the border or the tabs
- Tabs are clean outlines standing on the chat frame, labels centered, no more Blizzard tab art showing through
- The combat log's filter bar sits inside the chat frame and its tabs keep a normal size
- The scroll-to-bottom arrows sit inside the frame's corner
- Input box on top follows the tabs, stays on top after a reload, and no longer catches clicks above the tabs while you're not typing
- New: chat text size down to 8 (the tab menu stops at 12) and room between lines, in Edit Mode and the settings page
- Darker chat background on hover and brighter restored lines, easier to read
- Fixed: the objective tracker could get a fully dark background after it opened again

## v8-46 (2026-11-23)

- feat: smoother chat frame, chat options in Edit Mode, Sit button at camp
- The chat's bronze frame now curves smoothly into each tab, and tab labels sit centred in a darker box so they're easy to read
- Unselected chat tabs no longer fade out while the chat shows
- Edit Mode: BOLT's frames no longer show X/Y position boxes; drag them to move
- Edit Mode: the chat window lists all its options (clean window, messages on hover, buttons, input box, history, Battle.net notifications, copy chat, sound and popups)
- Edit Mode: Chat Popups can be made click-through, My Damage can hide Blizzard's meter window, Party frames can turn class-coloured names on
- Camp panel: a Sit button, and one bar for the warm-up, then the benefits' time left

## v8-45 (2026-11-22)

- fix: no more gaps between letters in the combat text above you
- Combat text ("Mana Low", spell names) now uses the same tight Cooldown Sans as the damage numbers

## v8-44 (2026-11-22)

- feat: chat window in a native bronze frame that wraps around its tabs
- The chat's hover background now sits in the minimap's bronze frame, with each tab framed to match
- Chat windows keep the font size you picked after a relog
- No more wide gaps inside words in the combat text above you (Cooldown Sans)

## v8-43 (2026-11-22)

- fix: tighter Cooldown Sans damage numbers, no more squares on action buttons
- Damage numbers in Cooldown Sans use a tighter version of the font, without the wide gaps between digits
- The range dot on action buttons (and a few other simple symbols) no longer shows as a square with Cooldown Sans
- Settings lists show "Everywhere" or "All" when every entry is ticked, instead of "Nothing" or "None"

## v8-42 (2026-11-22)

- feat: pick where Cooldown Sans is used
- Cooldown Sans Font: choose where it goes (interface, chat, nameplates, names above characters, damage numbers, combat text above you)
- Cooldown Sans no longer replaces other addons' fonts, so their symbols stop showing as squares
- The combat text above you ("Mana Low", incoming damage) no longer has big gaps between letters
- Damage numbers and names above characters switch after logging out to the character list and back in
- New /bolt font command shows which font the damage numbers and names were told to use

## v8-41 (2026-11-22)

- feat: Cooldown Sans font for the whole game
- New Cooldown Sans Font option (Interface settings, on by default): every text in the game, chat, tooltips, unit frames, nameplates and damage numbers, in ColdSnap's own easy-to-read rounded typeface
- Chat popups no longer error when the previous popup came from an instance with a hidden sender name
- Chat popups size themselves to their text, so lines no longer spill out of the box

- feat: Attack Key (was Wand & Pet Attack Key) swings in melee range for hunters
- Attack Key: the Wand & Pet Attack Key is now called Attack Key; your keybind and settings carry over
- Attack Key: on a hunter it starts a melee swing when the enemy is too close for Auto Shot, and Auto Shot when it is far enough

## v8-39 (2026-11-21)

- feat: the Wand & Pet Attack key starts Auto Shot for hunters
- Wand & Pet Attack Key: on a hunter it starts Auto Shot with your bow or gun instead of a wand's Shoot, along with sending your pet in

## v8-38 (2026-11-21)

- feat: Campfire benefits panel, guild chat popups, auto-thank and My Damage fixes
- Campfire: the camp bar, drawer, Sit button and right-click-to-sit are gone; near a campfire, a small panel in the My Damage style lists the camp benefits resting there gives you
- Campfire: it counts down the minute of warming up while you sit, then shows the benefits' time left; click-through, hidden in combat, width and opacity in Edit Mode

- fix: a chat window tucked past the screen edge stays there after a reload
